trust_decision.summary: The Ruby build shim decides whether a downloaded formula resource or URL patch may be extracted/applied and then executed by the build; it records the declared sha256 but never compares it, so any bytes curl returns are trusted.

landing_point.why: Summary names shim.rb and missing checksum; StagedResource#stage holds @sha256 but only curls and extracts it, the first obvious hole.
